items.text: Document titles differ: A wraps the name in decorative punctuation, while B uses an em dash and a location suffix.
items.evidence: A title '.:Alpine Everest Expedition & Trek :.'; B title 'Alpine Everest Expedition & Trek — Nepal'

items.text: A uses no HTML5 semantic landmarks. B uses header, nav, main, five sections and a footer.
items.evidence: A semantic counts all 0; B header 1, nav 1, main 1, section 5, footer 1

items.text: A has three h1 elements and no lower heading levels. B has one h1, four h2 and one h3.
items.evidence: A heading_outline: h1 x3 (Welcome, Gallery, Products); B: h1, h2 x4, h3 x1

items.text: A lays out the page with tables. B uses no tables and relies on CSS grid and flex.
items.evidence: A table 2, tr 6, td 7, display_grid 0, display_flex 0; B display_grid 11, display_flex 11

items.text: A loads 16 scripts and 4 external stylesheets. B has 1 script and no external stylesheets.
items.evidence: A scripts 16, stylesheets 4; B scripts 1, stylesheets 0

items.text: A has 20 images without alt text. B has none missing; its gallery thumbnails use empty alt and its logo and hero images have descriptive alt.
items.evidence: alt_missing A 20, B 0; B welcome-img alt 'Trekkers silhouetted against Himalayan peaks'

items.text: B has a real <button> element and label elements for its form. A has no buttons or labels.
items.evidence: A buttons 0, no label; B button 1, label 3

items.text: B wraps the contact details in an <address> element.
items.evidence: B tag_counts address 1; A has none

items.text: A uses Verdana throughout. B pairs Georgia serif with system-ui sans.
items.evidence: A fonts Verdana 195 / verdana 41 / Arial 4; B Georgia 67, system-ui 54

items.text: The h1 color and font family differ. A's is dark blue Verdana; B's is white Georgia, set over the hero gradient.
items.evidence: A h1 color rgb(39,66,120) Verdana; B rgb(255,255,255) Georgia serif

items.text: B defines an h2 at 36.8px. A has no h2.
items.evidence: A h2 null; B h2 36.8px/700

items.text: A sets its body copy in small, justified gray Verdana. B sets the About text in left-aligned Georgia at a larger size.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 welcome paragraphs justified, gray rgb(102,102,102) is #2 text color; B_slice_00 About paragraphs in serif

items.text: B adds small uppercase, letter-spaced teal eyebrow labels above its section headings. A has none.
items.evidence: B slices: 'ABOUT US', 'MOMENTS', 'FROM NEPAL', 'GET IN TOUCH'; teal rgb(95,158,166) in top_text_colors

items.text: A's body background is black. B's is warm cream.
B's hero is a full-width gradient from slate blue through teal to cream, which echoes A's sky colors.
items.evidence: B gradient_backgrounds 2; B_slice_00 hero band; A gradient_backgrounds 0 (its sky is an image)

items.text: A's main palette is navy, gray and bright cyan text, plus light teal input fields. B's is dark slate text, white, pale blue and teal.
A has no rounded corners. B rounds 31 elements at 8–15px and 6 as pills.
items.evidence: A border_radius bucket_0 241, others 0; B bucket_8_15 31, pill 6

items.text: A's layout is a two-column fixed-width table: a left sidebar holds navigation, the form and contact details, and the content sits on the right. B stacks full-width sections in a single column.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 left sidebar plus center column; B slices sequential sections

items.text: A's header is a white box with the AEG logo on the left and a broken image placeholder on the right. B uses a 'ALPINE EVEREST' text wordmark in a nav bar, and moves the logo into a rounded, shadowed card on the right of the hero.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 broken image icon at top center; A images aimg2/aimg7 natural 0×0 and overlapping; B businessname-bg.jpg at x 908, y 146

items.text: A's nav links are centered on a hatched gray strip with blue underline bars. B's nav links are plain white text, right-aligned in the top bar.
items.evidence: A_slice_00 nav strip; B_slice_00 top-right nav

items.text: A shows 'Featured Tours' as a sidebar list with rule separators. B shows the same items as a grid of rounded cream cards, each with a red arrow.

features.statement: Page uses HTML5 semantic landmarks (header, nav, main, multiple sections, footer) rather than generic containers.
Heading hierarchy is proper: a single h1 followed by several h2 section headings and an h3.
Layout is built with CSS grid and flexbox, with no table-based layout.
Page is lightweight: very few scripts and no external stylesheets, with styling kept inline.
Images have complete alt text: descriptive for meaningful images, empty for decorative thumbnails, none missing.
Forms use real button elements and label elements for inputs.
Contact details are wrapped in a semantic address element.
Typography pairs a serif display and body face with a system-ui sans for UI text.
Hero h1 is white serif text set over a gradient background.
Small uppercase, letter-spaced teal eyebrow labels sit above section headings.
Page background is a warm cream tone rather than black or stark white.
Hero is a full-width gradient band blending slate blue, teal and cream.
Palette is restrained: dark slate text, white, pale blue and teal accents, with red accents for calls to action.
Many elements have rounded corners, including cards, tiles and pill-shaped buttons and chips.
Content is stacked in full-width sections in a single column, with content aligned to a ~1040px column.
Site name appears as a plain text wordmark in a minimal top navigation bar.
Navigation links are plain white text, right-aligned in the top bar without decorative strips.
Feature lists are presented as a grid of rounded cream cards, each with an arrow accent.
Links like 'More →' are bold, red and left-aligned with an arrow glyph.
Images are shown in rounded, shadowed cards or tiles without caption bars.
Galleries are arranged in a wrapping multi-column grid that stays within the viewport.
Contact form sits in a rounded translucent card on a dark band, with large white inputs and a pill button.
Section backgrounds alternate between cream, white, gradient, slate and near-black to separate content.
Document title uses an em dash and a location suffix instead of decorative punctuation.
Head includes standard charset, viewport and description meta tags.
Tiles reuse one repeated placeholder image rather than distinct photos.
Spans are used for small labels and arrow glyphs inside components.
